summary_en: 6,000 shares (0.15% of shares outstanding) to be acquired gratuitously and cancelled following termination of employee stock grant trust. Acquisition date 2026-07-01, cancellation date 2026-07-31. Shares held in trust by Japan Custodian Bank.
title_en: Notification regarding gratuitous acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares in connection with termination of employee stock grant trust
translation_en_brief: AI inside Inc. announced on 26 June 2026 that it has resolved to acquire and cancel 6,000 treasury shares in connection with the termination of its employee stock grant trust (introduced in fiscal 2022 and administered with Resona Bank). The shares will be acquired gratuitously from Japan Custodian Bank (trust account) on 1 July 2026, representing the residual trust assets under the trust deed. The same 6,000 shares will be cancelled on 31 July 2026 pursuant to the Companies Act. The acquisition is at no cost; the cancellation is effective 31 July 2026. The shares represent 0.15% of shares outstanding (computed as 6,000 ÷ 4,000,000 ex-treasury denominator stated in the reference line).
